_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live squad state. Read by squad_state.py. TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md is the human narrative. Update BOTH after every actioned transfer.
as_at_note: GW1 pre-deadline. 3 free transfers actioned 10 Aug (unlimited pre-deadline, no hit cost): O'Reilly/Virgil/O.Dango -> Botman/Mosquera/Palmer, per the ROLE_INTEL.md intel-adjusted optimiser (Welbeck excluded - contaminated BHA prior). Plus 1 free transfer 11 Aug: Botman -> Van den Berg (BRE) - same price, near-identical xGC/90 (1.353 vs 1.356) but higher starts (75% vs 81%, +0.19 xP/GW) and no fitness-fragility flag; see TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md and ROLE_INTEL.md entry 6. Deadline Fri 21 Aug 2026 17:30 UTC. Actioned live on the FPL site by Sylvan, confirmed 11 Aug 2026.

squad.name: Raya
squad.selected_on: 19 clean sheets, best xGC in the league (0.74)

squad.name: Gabriel
squad.selected_on: xGC 0.72, 18 clean sheets, 23.7 bps/90 — and a 37% DC hit rate the old model scored at 0.20

squad.name: Mosquera
squad.selected_on: ROLE_INTEL intel (op=set stp->0.85, GW1-3): Saliba injured no return date, Timber out till 21 Aug — minutes opening in the league's best defence. 8.7 CBIT/90

squad.name: Van den Berg
squad.selected_on: 81% starts at £5.0m, 8.9 CBIT/90 clears the 10+ defensive-contribution threshold comfortably, xGC 1.36 in a defence that's already banked 8 clean sheets — reliability at budget-enabler price

squad.name: B.Fernandes
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.68 — the highest in the game. 100% starts

squad.name: Mbeumo
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.58, delta -3.0 — underperforming his chances. Cards reset each season, so last season's 4 yellows are a tendency, not a risk

squad.name: Sarr
squad.selected_on: flat xP 4.78 (before fixtures), xGI/90 0.50, delta -1.1 — only visible once gate 2 moved to a last-16 window

squad.name: Palmer
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.60 (xG 0.49 + xA 0.11), 87.5% starts — attacking output at the top end of the midfield pool, with a clean sheet route sitting on top if Chelsea's defence holds

squad.name: Schade
squad.selected_on: flat xP 4.55 (before fixtures), delta -1.1, 8 goals — underperforming his chances, so underpriced

squad.name: Thiago
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.62, 22 goals, 100% starts — the best availability in the squad

squad.name: Verbruggen
squad.selected_on: Goalkeeper cover at £4.5m — a genuine #1 (3420 minutes, 100% starts, 10 clean sheets, 2.79 saves/90), not a rotation risk on the bench

squad.name: Evanilson
squad.selected_on: First substitute. 94% starts and xP 3.61 — the most valuable autosub in the squad

squad.name: Justin
squad.selected_on: Bench cover at £4.5m with 100% starts and a 20% DC rate

squad.name: Shaw
squad.selected_on: Bench fodder — price and availability only. Merit plays no part in bench picks

bought_for_note: Pre-season, purchase price equals current price. Keep bought_for accurate from GW1 — FPL pays purchase price plus half any rise on sale.

set1.expires_note: GW19 deadline. Chips in set 1 do NOT carry over.

set2.expires_note: Second set unlocks after the set-1 deadline.
